mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are looking at overcast skies and 59 degrees at Verona Community Park with the First Quarter moon visible.

Road maintenance begins September 23, affecting Cross Country Road and E Verona Ave, so please use caution. Additionally, the City has officially adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan to guide our growth over the next ten years.

We have a busy weekend ahead, starting today with the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival, Live Music at Bailey's Run, Bike the Barns, and music at the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out Yoga at Insight Wellness.
Regarding local safety, on September 3, a driver was arrested for an O W I after crashing his vehicle on Shooting Star Road.
Culver's will open its doors today at 10:00 AM to serve up today's flavor of the day. Be sure to stop by and support our local team during their regular hours.
